blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Sibol Philippines’ Pokémon Unite squad is raring to make its mark in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 after its recent World Championship appearance. Japan, where Pokémon, the global phenomenon anime, originated, included Pokémon Unite — the multiplayer online battle arena mobile game as part of the esports events. Flying the flag for Team Philippines are Lawrence “RBX” Gatmaitan, Kim Rey “Kyy” Salazar, Duke “Dylan” Leoncio, Robert “SynC1” Mempin, and Michael “Miva” Ocio, and Lance David, under coach Albert Camp.
